parts.zh: M：嗯，我所在的气候研究中心将气候变化科学与经济和政策相关问题联系起来
W：那么，有多充分的证据表明气候变化正在发生呢？这确实是我们需要担心的事情
M：嗯，气候变化的大部分科学认识
W：那么我们正在做什么？我们能为此做些什么呢？
M：嗯，我认为我们需要发展相关科学
M：我们还需要提前做好规划
W: 当然是的。天赋在某种程度上会有所帮助
W: 我觉得视频中有一个有意思的观点

items.stem: What does Professor Henderson say about his main area of research?

choices.text: It tries to predict the possible trends of global climate change.
choices.zh: 它试图预测全球气候变化的可能趋势。

choices.text: It studies the impacts of global climate change on people's lives.
choices.zh: 它研究全球气候变化对人们生活的影响。

choices.text: It links the science of climate change to economic and policy issues.
choices.zh: 它将气候变化科学与经济和政策问题联系起来。

choices.text: It focuses on the efforts countries can make to deal with global warming.
choices.zh: 它关注各国为应对全球变暖可以做出的努力。

items.stem: What does Professor Henderson say about climate change?

choices.text: It will take a long time before a consensus is reached on its impact.
choices.zh: 要就其影响达成共识需要很长时间。

choices.text: It would be more costly to deal with its consequences than to avoid it.
choices.zh: 处理其后果的成本将高于避免它的成本。

choices.text: It is the most pressing issue confronting all countries.
choices.zh: 这是所有国家面临的最紧迫问题。

choices.text: It is bound to cause endless disputes among nations.
choices.zh: 它必然会在各国之间引发无休止的争端。

items.stem: What does Professor Henderson say is a top priority in combating climate change?

choices.text: The transition to low-carbon energy systems.
choices.zh: 向低碳能源系统转型。

choices.text: The cooperation among world major powers.
choices.zh: 世界主要大国之间的合作。

choices.text: The signing of a global agreement.
choices.zh: 签署一项全球协议。

choices.text: The raising of people's awareness.
choices.zh: 提高人们的意识。

items.stem: What does Professor Henderson advise us to do to better deal with climate change?

choices.text: Carry out more research on it.
choices.zh: 对其开展更多研究。

choices.text: Cut down energy consumption.
choices.zh: 减少能源消耗。

choices.text: Plan well in advance.
choices.zh: 提前做好规划。

choices.text: Adopt new technology.
choices.zh: 采用新技术。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: When luck plays a role.
choices.zh: 运气何时发挥作用。

choices.text: What determines success.
choices.zh: 什么决定成功。

choices.text: Whether practice makes perfect.
choices.zh: 熟能生巧是否成立。

choices.text: How important natural talent is.
choices.zh: 天赋有多重要。

items.stem: What is the woman's view of luck?

choices.text: It knocks at your door only once in a while.
choices.zh: 运气只是偶尔敲一次你的门。

choices.text: It is something that no one can possibly create.
choices.zh: 运气是任何人都不可能创造的东西。

choices.text: It comes naturally out of one's self-confidence.
choices.zh: 运气源于一个人的自信。

choices.text: It means being good at seizing opportunities.
choices.zh: 运气意味着善于抓住机会。

items.stem: What is the chief point the TED Talks video makes?

choices.text: Luck rarely contributes to a person's success.
choices.zh: 运气很少对一个人的成功有贡献。

choices.text: One must have natural talent to be successful.
choices.zh: 一个人必须有天赋才能成功。

choices.text: One should always be ready to seize opportunities.
choices.zh: 一个人应该随时准备抓住机会。

choices.text: Practice is essential to becoming good at something.
choices.zh: 练习对于精通某件事是必不可少的。

items.stem: What does the woman think is the funny thing in the TED Talks video?

choices.text: Putting time and effort into fun things is profitable.
choices.zh: 在有趣的事情上投入时间和精力是有益的。

choices.text: People who love what they do care little about money.
choices.zh: 热爱自己工作的人不太在乎金钱。

choices.text: Being passionate about work can make one wealthy.
choices.zh: 对工作充满热情可以使人富有。

choices.text: People in need of money work hard automatically.
choices.zh: 需要钱的人会自动努力工作。

items.stem: What does Devils Tower look like?

choices.text: The stump of a giant tree.
choices.zh: 一棵巨树的树桩。

choices.text: A huge piece of rock.
choices.zh: 一块巨大的岩石。

choices.text: The peak of a mountain.
choices.zh: 一座山的山峰。

choices.text: A tall chimney.
choices.zh: 一座高耸的烟囱。

items.stem: What caused the volcano's outer layers to wear away?

choices.text: Human activity.
choices.zh: 人类活动。

choices.text: Wind and water.
choices.zh: 风和水。

choices.text: Chemical processes.
choices.zh: 化学过程。

choices.text: Fire and fury.
choices.zh: 烈火与狂怒。

items.stem: What does an Indian legend say about Devils Tower?

choices.text: It is a historical monument.
choices.zh: 它是一座历史纪念碑。

choices.text: It was built in ancient times.
choices.zh: 它建于古代。

choices.text: It is Indians' sacred place for worship.
choices.zh: 它是印第安人崇拜的圣地。

choices.text: It was created by supernatural powers.
choices.zh: 它是由超自然力量创造的。

items.stem: How did the Rock God help the seven girls in the Indian legend?

choices.text: By sheltering them in a cave.
choices.zh: 在洞穴中庇护她们。

choices.text: By killing the attacking bears.
choices.zh: 杀死袭击的熊。

choices.text: By lifting them well above the ground.
choices.zh: 把她们举到远离地面的高处。

choices.text: By taking them to the top of a mountain.
choices.zh: 把她们带到山顶。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about drivers who stop at gas stations?

choices.text: They will buy something from the convenience stores.
choices.zh: 他们会从便利店买些东西。

choices.text: They will take advantage of the time to rest a while.
choices.zh: 他们会利用这段时间休息一会儿。

choices.text: They will have their vehicles washed or serviced.
choices.zh: 他们会让人洗车或保养车辆。

choices.text: They will pick up some souvenirs or gift items.
choices.zh: 他们会挑选一些纪念品或礼品。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about extravagances?

choices.text: They can bring only temporary pleasures.
choices.zh: 它们只能带来短暂的快乐。

choices.text: They are meant for the extremely wealthy.
choices.zh: 它们是为极其富有的人准备的。

choices.text: They should be done away with altogether.
choices.zh: 应该彻底摒弃它们。

choices.text: They may eventually drive one to bankruptcy.
choices.zh: 它们最终可能会使人破产。

items.stem: What does the speaker want to show by the example of the Chicago woman?

choices.text: A good way to socialize is to have daily lunch with one's colleagues.
choices.zh: 社交的好方法是每天与同事共进午餐。

choices.text: Retirement savings should come first in one's family budgeting.
choices.zh: 退休储蓄应该是家庭预算的首要考虑。

choices.text: A vacation will be affordable if one saves 20 dollars a week.
choices.zh: 如果每周存20美元,度假就能负担得起。

choices.text: Small daily savings can make a big difference in one's life.
choices.zh: 每天小额储蓄能对人的生活产生很大影响。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about negative emotions?

choices.text: They should be done away with.
choices.zh: 应该消除它们。

choices.text: They are necessary in our lives.
choices.zh: 它们在我们的生活中是必要的。

choices.text: They enrich our experience.
choices.zh: 它们丰富了我们的体验。

choices.text: They are harmful to health.
choices.zh: 它们对健康有害。

items.stem: What happens to people whose negative emotions are out of balance?

choices.text: They feel stressed out even without any challenges in life.
choices.zh: 即使生活中没有任何挑战,他们也感到压力很大。

choices.text: They feel too overwhelmed to deal with life's problems.
choices.zh: 他们感到太不知所措而无法应对生活中的问题。

choices.text: They are anxious to free themselves from life's troubles.
choices.zh: 他们急于让自己摆脱生活的烦恼。

choices.text: They are exhausted even without doing any heavy work.
choices.zh: 即使没有做任何重活,他们也筋疲力尽。

items.stem: How do positive emotions affect us?

choices.text: They expand our mind.
choices.zh: 它们拓展我们的思维。

choices.text: They prolong our lives.
choices.zh: 它们延长我们的生命。

choices.text: They narrow our focus.
choices.zh: 它们缩小我们的关注范围。

choices.text: They lessen our burdens.
choices.zh: 它们减轻我们的负担。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the skirt she is wearing now?

choices.text: It is not easily breakable.
choices.zh: 它不容易破损。

choices.text: It came from a 3D printer.
choices.zh: 它来自3D打印机。

choices.text: It represents the latest style.
choices.zh: 它代表了最新款式。

choices.text: It was made by a fashion designer.
choices.zh: 它是由时装设计师制作的。

items.stem: When did the speaker start experimenting with 3D printing?

choices.text: When she had just graduated from her college.
choices.zh: 当她刚从大学毕业时。

choices.text: When she attended a conference in New York.
choices.zh: 当她在纽约参加一个会议时。

choices.text: When she was studying at a fashion design school.
choices.zh: 当她在时装设计学校学习时。

choices.text: When she attended a fashion show nine months ago.
choices.zh: 当她在九个月前参加一场时装秀时。

items.stem: What was the problem with the material the speaker worked on at a New York fashion house?

choices.text: It was difficult to print.
choices.zh: 它很难打印。

choices.text: It was hard to come by.
choices.zh: 它很难获得。

choices.text: It was hard and breakable.
choices.zh: 它又硬又易碎。

choices.text: It was extremely expensive.
choices.zh: 它极其昂贵。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Filaflex?

choices.text: It is the latest model of a 3D printer.
choices.zh: 它是3D打印机的最新型号。

choices.text: It is a plastic widely used in 3D printing.
choices.zh: 它是3D打印中广泛使用的一种塑料。

choices.text: It gives fashion designers room for imagination.
choices.zh: 它为时装设计师提供了想象空间。

choices.text: It marks a breakthrough in printing material.
choices.zh: 它标志着打印材料的一个突破。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the problems facing small and medium sized enterprises?

choices.text: They arise from the advances in technology.
choices.zh: 这些问题源于技术进步。

choices.text: They have not been examined in detail so far.
choices.zh: 这些问题迄今尚未得到详细研究。

choices.text: They are easy to solve with modern technology.
choices.zh: 这些问题利用现代技术很容易解决。

choices.text: They can't be solved without government support.
choices.zh: 这些问题没有政府支持就无法解决。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the technology industry?

choices.text: It is attractive to entrepreneurs.
choices.zh: 它对企业家很有吸引力。

choices.text: It demands huge investment.
choices.zh: 它需要巨额投资。

choices.text: It focuses on new products.
choices.zh: 它专注于新产品。

choices.text: It is intensely competitive.
choices.zh: 它竞争激烈。

items.stem: What is a practical solution to the problems of small and medium-sized businesses?

choices.text: Cooperation with big companies.
choices.zh: 与大公司合作。

choices.text: Recruiting more qualified staff.
choices.zh: 招聘更多合格的员工。

choices.text: In-service training of IT personnel.
choices.zh: 对信息技术人员进行在职培训。

choices.text: Sharing of costs with each other.
choices.zh: 彼此分担成本。
